work.author: Gregorius Papa XV,
work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. LVII heading and synopsis 93052–93056 and explicit protocol 93058–93059 establish the St Anne act. Extend the beginning to 93045 to retain the act-specific marginal exordium about Anne, printed before the numbered heading and continued in later marginal labels. The preceding act has already closed with its dating clause 93038–93040 and printed date 93042. The preamble and §§1–4 follow coherently through the own dating clause 93171–93173 and printed date 93175. Historical note 93065–93074 treats the same feasts and is retained. LVIII begins at 93178 with a new protocol 93190.
